hero.description: I'm a full stack developer focused on front-end. I work with React, Next.js and TypeScript to turn ideas into interfaces and digital experiences.

about.title: The person behind the interface
about.description: I like to understand an application beyond the screen: how data arrives, how states connect and how the interface responds to each interaction. My work brings together interface development, API integration, testing and technical documentation.

work.title: Development day to day
work.description: I work at {{company}}, on digital products for {{team}}. Previously, I worked at {{previousCompany}} on B2C E-care applications for {{previousProduct}}.

education.title: An education in software
education.description: I hold a technology degree in Multiplatform Software Development from {{school}} and a postgraduate qualification in Full Stack Development and Cloud Computing from {{postgraduateSchool}}.

learning.title: Continuous learning
learning.description: I am deepening my studies in systems architecture and development with an emphasis on design patterns, alongside automated testing and delivery processes.

projectDescriptions.border: A responsive puppy catalogue with filters, detail pages and an image gallery.
projectDescriptions.threadflow: A product landing page with interactive sections and structured content for navigation and SEO.
projectDescriptions.maestri: An institutional website with consumer law content, an informational deadline calculator and contact via WhatsApp or email.

game.name: Lucky Canopy
game.description: A three-reel experience designed to explore interfaces and interactions. A small project to follow from the first click to the result.

credits.title: Virtual credits
credits.description: The concept starts with 1,000 virtual credits, with no payments or monetary value.

responsive.title: Responsive interface
responsive.description: A composition that adapts from mobile to desktop while keeping the machine in focus.

history.title: Round history
history.description: The game will include a summary of the last five rounds, with bets and results.

game.disclaimer: A demo with no real money.
game.progress: In development. The machines on this page are visual previews; the demo does not run rounds yet.

preview.heroCaption: Fig. 1 — Illustrative preview: three reels, one line. Sample values.
preview.detailCaption: Fig. 2 — A visual study of a match. Controls and values are illustrative.

interface.title: Interface and responsiveness
interface.description: One column on mobile and more room for the composition on desktop. Theme, navigation and visible focus share the same components throughout the application.

data.title: Application data and states
data.description: The foundation already includes an HTTP query with loading and error states. Server-confirmed game results will be the next step in separating data from presentation.

motion.title: Interactions and animation
motion.description: The game is designed to stop the reels in sequence, 260 ms apart. Results will also be communicated through text, respecting reduced motion preferences.

game.description: Three reels, four symbols and one winning line. Explore the interface and the demo rules.

sound.unavailable: Audio could not be enabled in this browser. The interface remains available without sound.

rules.title: Combinations
rules.intro: The game concept uses 1,000 virtual credits and bets of 10, 25 or 50. Three identical symbols on the centre line form a match. There are no payments, withdrawals or monetary value.
rules.description: Display values for the selected bet: {{bet}} credits.
rules.note: The payout is the total credited for the round; the bet is deducted once. No match means no prize. This is an illustrative table with no claim about probabilities or RTP.

reset.title: Reset this example?
reset.description: Only the visual example will return to 1,000 credits and an empty history. No server session or round will be changed.

examples.title: Interface examples
examples.description: Local scenarios with fixed values, no bets, random draws or round connection. Animate replays a known preview; it does not calculate a new result. Changing the scenario interrupts the previous animation.

unavailable.title: Rounds are coming soon
unavailable.body: There is no game session available yet. Select a bet, check the paytable and explore the interface examples. No credits will be moved.

loading.title: Loading demo…
loading.body: Waiting for the data needed to display the session. Starting another round remains blocked.

ready.title: Ready to explore
ready.body: Fixed example bet: {{bet}} credits. The animation shows a known scenario without sending a bet.

spinning.title: Spinning…
spinning.body: An example animation is in progress. Wait for all three reels to stop; the values have not yet been replaced by the final snapshot.

stopping.title: Presenting the result…
stopping.body: The reels stop in sequence. The complete snapshot will appear when the animation finishes.

win.title: Match! +{{prize}} credits
win.body: Three flowers on the line in this example. The displayed prize is the total credited for a bet of {{bet}} credits.

loss.title: No match this round
loss.body: This snapshot illustrates a round with no prize and a bet of {{bet}} credits. No new bet was placed.

insufficient.title: Insufficient balance
insufficient.body: The example has {{balance}} credits and a bet of {{bet}}. In an available session, choose a smaller bet or reset when no round is pending.

offline.title: Offline
offline.body: This scenario represents an unavailable connection. A new round should wait until the session is restored.

verifying.title: Checking result…
verifying.body: The result is not confirmed yet. Do not start another round while the check is pending.

failed.title: The result could not be confirmed
failed.body: The displayed value is the last reference, not a guarantee of an up-to-date balance. Check the same result before continuing, without resending the bet.
